title: Remove measured local verification latency
goal: Preserve real transfer, publisher digest, transaction lock, durable publication and cancellation checks while measuring retry budgets without sleeping through them; production sleep policy stays unchanged. Preserve real progress and stall deadlines with explicit elapsed assertions. Reduce recording-forwarder Nagle latency without changing any channel or privacy assertion. Native scoped claim only; no integration or production qualification. The exploratory sandbox changes were rejected and restored byte-for-byte after no whole-library speed gain was measured. Preserve all model-manager tests by moving the existing unit suite to src/tests, lower the fixed gemi source ceiling from 16,737 to 15,938, and retain companion guard changes in diagnostic composition.
